question: Should the Android-area owner accept Kotlin 2.4.10 after the exact-head Android build and flavor-test evidence completes?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but a Kotlin Gradle plugin upgrade can affect Compose compilation and serialization across Android variants; the current evidence does not yet establish compatibility.

options.title: Wait for Android compatibility evidence
options.body: Let the current-head Android build, lint, and flavor-test jobs finish and merge only if their results confirm the shared plugin upgrade is compatible.

options.title: Pause this version bump
options.body: Close or defer the update if Android ownership does not want to adopt Kotlin 2.4.10 in the current release train.
